name: Next_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its right arm forward briefly as if pointing or gesturing towards the next item, then returns to neutral.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture facing forward. It raises its right arm forward with the elbow bent, bringing the hand to about chest height while slightly rotating the wrist inward. After a brief pause at the peak of the gesture, it smoothly lowers the right arm back down to its side, returning to the neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The right arm extends slightly forward, so ensure there is clear space directly in front of the robot.
